title: Marketplace Orders Conditions of Sale: Cancellation Before Shipment
content:
**Condition.** A Marketplace Orders order can be cancelled only while it is still placed; once it has shipped the buyer's only route is a return. A buyer cancellation is the buyer's own decision and is confirmed by the buyer. Because parcel options capture payment at shipment, cancelling a placed parcel order books no refund; a freight order, captured at placement, is refunded in full on cancellation (item, shipping and tax components), funded by the seller. A cancellation initiated by the seller is recorded against the seller's performance standing when the option's seller-cancellation defect setting is true; cancellations by the buyer or by Northloop never are.

## Branches of the condition

| Order state | Delivery option | Effect of cancellation |
|---|---|---|
| placed | a parcel option | the order is cancelled; no refund is booked, since nothing has been captured |
| placed | Large Item Freight Delivery | the order is cancelled and refunded in full (item, shipping and tax components), funded by the seller |
| shipped or later | any | no cancellation; the buyer's only route is a return |

| Who cancels | Recorded against the seller's performance standing |
|---|---|
| the seller | yes, where the option's seller-cancellation defect setting is true |
| the buyer | never |
| Northloop | never |

### Hypothetical cases

1. A hypothetical buyer asks to cancel a placed order on Fulfilled by Northloop Standard. The cancellation is the buyer's own decision, confirmed by the buyer; no refund is booked because payment has not been captured.
2. A hypothetical placed Large Item Freight Delivery order of USD 1,200.00 item price, USD 89.00 shipping and USD 96.00 tax is cancelled. Each of the three components is refunded in full, funded by the seller. The amounts are example inputs.
